'''Gray noise generators''' were devices which produced gray noise. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used the devices to mask the sound of large machines during covert operations. The noise pulses produced were intensely painful to [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] but were not audible to all [[Species/Legends|species]].
